# captoo-warehouse:sov_weekly_swings

**Class:** data
**Captured:** 2026-09-27 · **By:** captoo team · **Where:** `materials/data-sov-weekly-swings.md`, captoo warehouse, pasted output (synthetic, written for the BuilderOS rehearsal)

Query: week-over-week change in share of voice per account and engine, 2026-W27 to 2026-W38, 247 accounts x 3 engines x 11 week pairs = 8,151 observations. Source: captoo warehouse, pasted output.

| absolute week-over-week change | observations | share |
|---|---|---|
| under 5 points | 6,847 | 84.0% |
| 5 to 10 points | 896 | 11.0% |
| 10 to 20 points | 326 | 4.0% |
| over 20 points | 82 | 1.0% |

Drops only (negative change) of 10 points or more: 204 observations, across 131 accounts.
Of the 204, 58 recovered to within 5 points of the previous level the following week.
